name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
description: The creature beats its wings. Each creature within 10 ft. of the creature must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. The creature can then fly up to half its flying speed.
